summary: AAPResourcePicker supported resource values: inventories (single-select), credentials (multi-select with type: array) and organizations (single-select). The portal queries the AAP API to list them.
questions: Which resource types can AAPResourcePicker select?
Is the credentials picker single or multi-select?

answer_card.title: AAPResourcePicker resource values
answer_card.answer_md:
| `resource` | AAP resource | Selection |
|---|---|---|
| `inventories` | Inventories | single-select |
| `credentials` | Credentials | multi-select (`type: array`) |
| `organizations` | Organizations | single-select |
